proposed.text: Given a 500 sqm R-2 lot, a problem-stated AMBF of 325 sqm, a 15 m BHL, 3.0 m floor-to-floor height, and a 2.5 FLAR cap, what source-safe TGFA result follows?

options.text: 1,250 sqm, because max FLAR alone is always fully buildable
975 sqm: BHL allows 5 floors, but the 2.5 FLAR cap allows only 3 full 325 sqm floors
1,500 sqm, because BHL controls over FLAR
650 sqm, because only 2 floors are allowed

proposed.rationale: PD 1096 supports the AMBF/BHL/FLAR/TGFA workflow; the exact AMBF is treated as a problem-stated local zoning input. Max TGFA by FLAR is 500 x 2.5 = 1,250 sqm; 1,250 / 325 = 3.84, so only 3 full floors fit: 975 sqm.
proposed.explanation: Use the given local-zoning input rather than a memorized PSO. The FLAR cap prevents all five BHL floors from being used at the stated footprint.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 Rule VII/VIII; LGU zoning input stated in item
